suggestions.title: Settle the capture question before anything is scheduled
options: A: Ask NFL for written consent to capture the injury report (DR-29, DR-54).
B: Use an authorised data feed for official reports.
C: Keep manual, one-off reads with recorded hashes and a plain statement that they are not a series.
suggestions.recommended: Decide A or B before C, because C can still count as systematic retrieval.
